topic.title: Nepal Share Market
topic.shortInfo: Learn the NEPSE journey from beginner concepts to confident investing.

chapters.title: Share Market Basics
chapters.shortInfo: Start with ownership, shares, and why markets exist.

lessons.title: What Is a Share?
lessons.summary: Understand what owning a share means in real life.

cards.front: Imagine a bakery in Kathmandu lets 100 people each own a tiny piece of it. What is each piece called?
cards.back: That piece is a share. Buying one means you own a small part of the business.
cards.label: Ownership

cards.front: Why would a company sell shares instead of asking only banks for money?
cards.back: Selling shares helps a company raise money from the public without taking only loan-based financing.
cards.label: Capital raising

quiz.question: If you buy a share, what do you get?
quiz.explanation: A share represents ownership, even if the ownership is very small.

quiz.question: Why do companies issue shares?
quiz.explanation: Shares are one way for companies to raise funds for growth.

lessons.title: What Is NEPSE?
lessons.summary: Learn what the Nepal Stock Exchange does.

cards.front: You want to buy or sell shares in Nepal. Where would those trades be organized?
cards.back: They are organized through NEPSE, the Nepal Stock Exchange.
cards.label: Exchange

cards.front: Why is a stock exchange useful to investors and companies?
cards.back: It creates an organized market where shares can be bought, sold, and priced transparently.
cards.label: Market role

quiz.question: NEPSE is:
quiz.explanation: NEPSE is the stock exchange where listed shares are traded in Nepal.
